summary: The consolidation is left half-done (a sixth identical private wrapper restatement stays behind), three of the new lemmas unfold to bare `rfl` where the corresponding Mathlib lemma would serve as the proof term, and two of them collide with Mathlib simp lemmas of the same name and LHS.
